title: Chapter 1138
text:
All of a sudden, surprise and doubt filled his mind.

Decades had passed, but Han Xiao still remembered it clearly. He used to think that Destiny's Child was just a simple foreseer who died in the nuclear explosion of the Germinal Organization.

However, it seemed that Destiny's Child was hiding more secrets. Not only did he reappear in the Blue Star, but he was also related to the Information Form.

Originally, he thought that the Germinal Organization was already at its limit having him, Hila, and Aurora. Who would have thought that Destiny's Child, who had died so early, was also not that simple? It was truly a place full of hidden talents!

Even if the Germinal Organization leader suddenly revived and jumped in front of him one day, he probably would not be surprised anymore.

Destiny's Child, what exactly is he …

Han Xiao was shocked. He could not rest assured until he understood the truth.

This time, Harrison's voice sounded in his ears.

"… Army Commander?"

Han Xiao came back to his senses and realized that the three of them were staring at him. In their eyes, Black Star suddenly went into a daze.

Aesop shook his head and thought that he understood why Han Xiao was silent. He explained, "Even the three Universal Civilizations only know a little about the Information Form Theory and haven't been able to study it fully. I know this request might be a little difficult for you."

Rody panicked and said with despair, "Then what should I do? If even His Excellency Black Star can't do it, who can save me? Good people, please help me convince His Excellency Black Star. I … I really don't have a way! "

Hearing that, Han Xiao waved his hand. "Don't worry, I'll try to help you."

"That's great. Thank you, Black … Huh?" Rody subconsciously thanked him, but halfway through, he was stunned. He stared at Han Xiao with his eyes wide open with shock and surprise.

Aesop and Harrison were also shocked and looked at Han Xiao in surprise.

"Army Commander, you can see him?"

"Yes, I can."

"But you clearly … Did you find a way? But you didn't do anything! "Aesop was surprised.

Han Xiao coughed dryly and said, "A real High Dimensional Information Form life form can choose who observes them. It's possible that his strong will triggered the characteristics of his own Information Form and actively created an information entanglement with me … To put it simply, he subjectively moved me out of the blacklist."

A question mark popped up above Harrison's head. His big eyes were filled with confusion.

There was such a thing?

Aesop thought about it and accepted this explanation. He muttered to himself, "This makes sense. He may have inherited this trait, but he can't control it actively. However, he may be able to subconsciously influence it …"

Han Xiao looked at him with a smile and silently cheered for the old man in his heart.

— — That's the feeling. Please continue to imagine and help me convince yourself.

Like a drowning man grasping at the last straw, Rody put his hands on the table and trembled with excitement. "Thank you so much," he said in a trembling voice. "Thank you so much! You're really like what the news says. Not only are you a great man of Blue Star, but you're also a great man of the entire universe! You're too noble! To tell you the truth, in my forty-eight years of life, I only admire one person, and that's you! I've been looking up to you as a role model since I was young. You're the light in my life, the motivation to move forward, and the inspiration to grow up … "

After a series of compliments, Han Xiao could not help but smile appreciatively. He loved to hear such honest words.

But soon, he put away his smile and waved his hand, signaling Luo Di to calm down.

"You don't have to be so grateful to me. To be honest, I'm only helping you because I'm interested in your mutation and want to study it. As for whether I can cure you, I can't guarantee."

"I understand. I have nothing else to repay you with. I'll do my best to cooperate with your research." Rody nodded.

Han Xiao nodded with satisfaction.

There was no free lunch in the world. It was convenient for Rody to know that. If Rody were to ask for help and act like he was paranoid, Han Xiao might use a more forceful method and not cooperate unless he used violence.

He stood up and walked around Luo Di, sizing him up from head to toe. Suddenly, he had a thought.

That's right, I've already completed the information entanglement step with him. It should be fine to stab him now.

With this thought, Han Xiao immediately took action.

He raised his finger, and a nanoparticle was compressed and formed into a thin metal needle.

He flipped his wrist and carefully stabbed it into Rody's arm. The strength he used was similar to an ordinary person picking up an ant with their fingers, afraid that the ant would be crushed to death if they used too much strength.

The thin needle retracted as soon as it touched him. Han Xiao immediately looked at the interface. As expected, damage was dealt. The combat information appeared, and Rody's attributes were displayed.

The target was just an ordinary person. His interface was extremely clean, and all of his abilities were within the range of an ordinary person. There were only a few lines of words, which was completely different from the interface of a Super.

Only one anomaly caught Han Xiao's attention. First, Rody's status bar maintained a special status, which was exactly the same as the mission name.

(Destiny's Child-Sub-body Transformation]: The Primal Esper Ability Entity 'Destiny's Child' has set off an Information Form disturbance, randomly creating all kinds of 'sub-bodies' in the entire universe. You are one of the chosen random numbers. A mutation will occur in your body. The characteristics of the Information Form will gradually appear in your body, and you will randomly be born with some of the related abilities of Destiny's Child. During the transformation process, not only will your body change, but your personality will also gradually change. When this process is over, you may lose most of your desires and emotions. You may lose your memories. You may believe in a false life experience. A brand new personality and a brand new self will be born in your body.]

Current Transformation Progress: 37.1%

Han Xiao's eyes widened as he caught the key information.

"Destiny's Child is a Primal Esper Ability Entity? Randomly creating sub-bodies in the entire universe? "

This was a little unexpected. On the Super High Risk Esper Ability List, there was no Destiny's Child. In his previous life, the players also did not discover any related information. Could this be a Primal Esper Ability that had not been discovered or publicized?

Looking at the introduction on the interface, Han Xiao's imagination ran wild.

If Destiny's Child has such a mechanism, the one in the Germinal Organization in Version 1.0 should only be a sub-body and not a Primal Esper Ability Entity …

Rody hasn't completely transformed yet. Once he becomes a complete Destiny's Child sub-body, his personality will be replaced, and it might be another form of death.

Han Xiao was deep in thought.

Although he knew that the true face of Destiny's Child was a Primal Esper Ability Entity, there were still many mysteries. Perhaps Ah Hun and Ah Sheng, who were also Primal Esper Ability Entities, had information on this.

Han Xiao told them to wait in the room while he went to another room, closed the door, opened the secondary dimensional army box, and took out the Mysterious Energy Host. He also sent a long-distance message to Aurora and added the Holy Light Particle into the chat channel.

"Black Star! Why are you looking for us? Let's chat more! "

The Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy was very happy. He did not have a host and was almost bored to death in a metal carrier without a soul.

"I have something to ask you guys," Han Xiao said with a deep voice. "Do you guys know a Primal Esper Ability Entity called Destiny's Child?"

Considering the different names, Han Xiao specifically repeated some of the characteristics of Destiny's Child, which were all inferred from the information on the interface.

Hearing this, the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy and the Holy Light Particle suddenly fell silent. After a while, they asked in confusion.

"This guy … I think I've seen him before?"

"Strange, did I sleep too much? I vaguely remember that I know him, but I just can't remember …"

This feeling was like suddenly realizing that someone looked very familiar, but they just could not remember who he was.

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes and guessed, "According to the intelligence, Destiny's Child has a lot to do with Information Forms. Maybe it's because of this that the two of you can't remember."

The two of them tried their best to recall, hesitated, and said, "Maybe you're right. We can't remember any more information about it. We only remember that in our impression, there is a Primal Esper Ability Entity that can switch between a physical form and a High-Dimensional Information Form. It has the ability to predict the future and interfere with reality. Maybe this is the Destiny's Child you mentioned."

It seems like I can't get any more information from them …

Han Xiao's eyes moved, and he changed the topic. "Then, do you guys know Soul Flame? It's also a Primal Esper Ability Entity."

"I know this one!" The Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy quickly answered, afraid that the Holy Light Particle would take away the chance to talk. "This guy comes and goes like a shadow. I haven't seen it many times. The last time I heard about it was during the exploration era. It seemed to have chosen a Primordial One as its host and then disappeared for many years."

Han Xiao's eyes sparkled.

According to Aesop's intelligence, Oathkeeper was very likely the host of Soul Flame. He might even be the Primordial One that the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy was talking about. As long as he knew his identity, he would be able to see through Oathkeeper's true identity.

"Do you still remember who that Primordial One is?" Han Xiao quickly asked.

"I only remember his nickname. I think it's [Soul Emperor], which means' Emperor of Souls'. He's a powerful psychic Esper … but he seems to have died in battle."

Wow, this nickname sounds like it's not to be messed with.

Han Xiao noted it down and planned to ask for internal information from the dynasty when he returned to investigate the life of this' Soul Emperor '.

As for something as mysterious as Destiny's Child, the dynasty might not have records of it.

"Since Destiny's Child is a Primordial Esper Ability Entity, and the Holy Covenant is an expert on Primordial Esper Abilities … maybe it's not a bad choice to ask them."

Han Xiao nodded and made up his mind. After completing the deal with the Holy Covenant, he would ask Oathkeeper about the origin of Destiny's Child. Maybe he could get some information from the Holy Covenant.

Suddenly, he had a guess.

"Speaking of which, could Destiny's Child be in the hands of the Holy Covenant? Hmm, I think there's a chance, but it's not high. Destiny's Child can create disturbances, so it should be free, not like it's being taken in … Heh, why worry so much? I won't lose anything by asking anyway. "

Han Xiao curled his lips.

As for whether Oathkeeper could accept it or not …

Hmm, I think his mental fortitude should be pretty strong.

After asking all the questions, just as Han Xiao was about to turn off the communication, he suddenly thought of something and said to the Holy Light Particle, "Oh, right.

I'm going to cut off a small piece of your body and use it to make a deal with someone else. I'm letting you know so that you can be mentally prepared. "

The Holy Light Particle's light cluster froze in midair. It was like a bolt out of the blue.

The Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy was stunned for a moment before laughing out loud in schadenfreude.

"Who told you to laugh at me? You can't escape the same fate, hahahaha!"

The Holy Light Particle was speechless.

So tired. I feel like I won't love again.
